
# ASV的初始细胞数量依赖和偏好

## 加载需要的包

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
```


### 加载数据集

```{r}
physeq = readRDS("./data/dada2/microplate/filtered/physeq.rds") #读取
physeq
```

```{r}
rename_asv <- function(physeq, prefix="ASV"){
  new_names <- paste0(prefix, seq_len(ntaxa(physeq)))
  taxa_names(physeq) <- new_names
  physeq}

physeq <- rename_asv(physeq, prefix="ASV")
```


### 数据集清洗

保险起见去丰度为0的ASV避免影响后续的网络构建以及分析。

```{r}
ps_final <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(physeq) > 0, physeq)
```

## ASV偏好相关性

### 偏好相关性计算

```{r}
asv_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_final), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_final)) { 
  asv_mat <- t(asv_mat) 
}
asv_df <- as.data.frame(asv_mat)

cell_nums <- as.numeric(as.character(sample_data(ps_final)$cell_num))
cor_results <- data.frame(ASV_ID = character(), Rho = numeric(), Pval = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
for(asv in colnames(asv_df)) {
  test <- cor.test(asv_df[[asv]], cell_nums, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  cor_results <- rbind(cor_results, data.frame(ASV_ID = asv, Rho = test$estimate, Pval = test$p.value))
}

final_classification <- cor_results %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(Pval, method = "fdr")) %>%
  mutate(
    Density_Preference = case_when(
      Pval < 0.05 & Rho > 0 ~ "High_Density_Enriched", 
      Pval < 0.05 & Rho < 0 ~ "Low_Density_Enriched",  
      TRUE ~ "Not_Significant"                         
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Pval, desc(abs(Rho)))
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_final)) %>% rownames_to_column(var = "ASV_ID")
final_results_with_tax <- left_join(final_classification, tax_df, by = "ASV_ID")

print(table(final_results_with_tax$Density_Preference))
top_high <- final_results_with_tax %>% filter(Density_Preference == "High_Density_Enriched") %>% head(10)
top_low <- final_results_with_tax %>% filter(Density_Preference == "Low_Density_Enriched") %>% head(10)
print(top_high %>% select(ASV_ID, Rho, Pval, Genus))
print(top_low %>% select(ASV_ID, Rho, Pval, Genus))

```

### 偏好相关性可视化

```{r}
genus_colors <- readRDS("./data/dada2/microplate/top10_genus_colors.rds")
if (!"Other" %in% names(genus_colors)) genus_colors["Other"] <- "#666666" 
plot_colors <- genus_colors

 plot_colors["Not_Significant"] <- "#FFF8DC" 

plot_df <- final_results_with_tax %>%
  mutate(
    PlotGenus = as.character(Genus),
    PlotGenus = ifelse(PlotGenus %in% names(genus_colors), PlotGenus, "Other"),
    PlotGenus = ifelse(Density_Preference == "Not_Significant", "Not_Significant", PlotGenus)
  )

label_data <- plot_df %>%
  filter(Density_Preference != "Not_Significant") %>% 
  arrange(Pval, desc(abs(Rho))) %>% 
  head(10) %>%
  mutate(PlotLabel = ASV_ID)

max_rho <- max(abs(plot_df$Rho), na.rm = TRUE)
x_limit <- ceiling(max_rho * 10) / 10 

p_volcano_layered <- ggplot(data = plot_df, 
                            aes(x = Rho, y = -log10(Pval))) +

  geom_jitter(data = filter(plot_df, Density_Preference == "Not_Significant"),
              aes(fill = PlotGenus), 
              shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.4, 
              size = 2, 
              position = position_jitter(width = 0.01, height = 0.1, seed = 123)) + 

  geom_jitter(data = filter(plot_df, Density_Preference != "Not_Significant"),
              aes(fill = PlotGenus), 
              shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.3, alpha = 0.85, 
              size = 2, 
              position = position_jitter(width = 0.005, height = 0.05, seed = 123)) + 

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey20", size = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", size = 0.4) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = plot_colors) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE, title = NULL)) + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-x_limit, x_limit), 
                     breaks = seq(-x_limit, x_limit, by = 0.2)) +
  geom_text_repel(data = label_data, 
                  aes(label = PlotLabel), 
                  color = "black", 
                  size = 4, 
                  fontface = "bold",            
                  box.padding = 0.7, 
                  point.padding = 0.4, 
                  min.segment.length = 0,       
                  segment.color = "grey30", 
                  segment.size = 0.4,
                  arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.015, "npc"), type = "closed"), 
                  max.overlaps = 50,
                  show.legend = FALSE) + 

  labs(title = "ASV Enrichment along Cell Number Gradient",
       x = "Spearman Correlation Coefficient (Rho)",
       y = expression(bold(-log[10]("P-value"))), 
       subtitle = "Significant drivers colored by taxonomic affiliation") +

  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 0.85, 
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 15),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11, color = "grey40", margin = margin(b=15)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    axis.line = element_line(size = 0.6, color = "black"), 
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "bottom", 
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0, unit = "pt"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_volcano_layered)
```

### 主导物种的ASV偏好分布

```{r}
ps_asv_relabund <- transform_sample_counts(physeq, function(x) x / sum(x, na.rm = TRUE))

plot_genera <- c("Klebsiella", "Pseudomonas")
ps_target <- subset_taxa(ps_asv_relabund, Genus %in% plot_genera)


df_asv <- psmelt(ps_target) %>% as_tibble()

plot_data <- df_asv %>% 
  group_by(carbon, cell_num, Genus, OTU) %>% 
  summarise(meanAbundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(OTU) %>% 
  filter(max(meanAbundance) > 0.01) %>% 
  ungroup()

plot_data_agg <- plot_data %>% 
  left_join(final_classification %>% select(ASV_ID, Density_Preference), 
            by = c("OTU" = "ASV_ID")) %>% 
  mutate(Density_Preference = replace_na(Density_Preference, "Not_Significant")) %>% 
  mutate(Density_Preference = factor(Density_Preference, 
                                     levels = c("Not_Significant",         
                                                "High_Density_Enriched",   
                                                "Low_Density_Enriched"))) %>% 
  
  group_by(carbon, Genus, cell_num, Density_Preference) %>% 
  summarise(TotalAbundance = sum(meanAbundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

p_combined <- ggplot(plot_data_agg, aes(x = as.factor(cell_num), 
                                        y = TotalAbundance, 
                                        fill = Density_Preference)) + 

  geom_col(width = 0.8, color = "white", size = 0.2) + 
  facet_grid(Genus ~ carbon, scales = "free_y") +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "High_Density_Enriched" = "#E64B35",  
    "Low_Density_Enriched"  = "#4DBBD5",  
    "Not_Significant"       = "#CCCCCC"   
  )) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(
    x = "Initial Cell Number", 
    y = "Relative Abundance", 
    fill = "Density Preference (Spearman)",
    title = "Guild Dynamics Driven by Density Preference"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_combined)
```
